decisions.reason: The one-video source rule applies to the requalification batch, not the previously completed initial trial.
The batch count and acceptance condition remain unchanged; the new source-material rule is independently represented by REQ_CLIP_SOURCE_SELECTION.
The source decision is scoped to the later requalification batch and does not alter the earlier extended-trial batch.
The complete-teaching-moment standard is established independently by another clause in message 84; changing the batch's source video does not modify that standard.
Requiring all requalification clips to come from one video neither changes nor removes the existing effective-hook requirement.
Message 84 independently modifies the visual-editing standard through its editing-style clause, but the source-selection change requires no additional alteration to that existing same-message Event.
The one-video source rule does not change the requirement to use color in captions.
The source-selection change does not alter the existing 30–90-second duration requirement.
